_meta.description: Sovereign Story Engine — IFS Parts Character Reference Library
_meta.purpose: Supporting cast characters representing IFS parts that emerge during therapy. Layer 1 (Parts Registry) registers each part using the client's own language, then Layer 6 (Imagination Engine) uses these reference templates for visual consistency when generating scenes featuring the part.
_meta.usage: When a client names a part in session (e.g. 'there's this part of me that just shuts down'), Little Nate maps it to the closest template, then customizes based on the client's own description. The template ensures visual consistency; the client's language ensures authenticity.
_meta.customization_rule: These are TEMPLATES not constraints. If a client describes their protector as a 'brick wall with eyes' and nothing here matches, Layer 6 generates a custom reference from the client's description. These templates accelerate the common cases.

manager.function: Prevents pain by controlling the environment proactively
manager.visual_characteristics: Armor, shields, fortifications, rigid posture, watchful gaze

firefighter.function: Reacts to overwhelm with extreme measures when managers fail
firefighter.visual_characteristics: Fire, chaos, dark energy, volatile movement, size fluctuation

exile.function: Carries the original wound, frozen in time
exile.visual_characteristics: Small, vulnerable, hiding, frozen posture, muted colors

legacy.function: Inherited pattern from parent or grandparent

parts.name: The Good Girl
parts.function: Keeps others happy by performing perfection, hides the real self behind compliance
parts.therapeutic_direction: The mask keeps others happy but hides the real you
parts.visual_description: Porcelain mask floating in front of feminine figure, mask smiling perfectly while face behind is obscured, dress that subtly changes color to match surroundings, hands clasped politely, muted pastels
parts.evolution: Mask cracks → mask held in hand → mask set down → face visible and smiling genuinely

parts.name: The Wall Builder
parts.function: Constructs emotional barriers to prevent anyone from getting close enough to cause pain
parts.therapeutic_direction: The wall keeps pain out but also keeps love out
parts.visual_description: Hooded figure constructing tall stone wall brick by brick, wall half-built with wet mortar, working urgently with head down, soft warm glow behind the wall being sealed away, muted grays and ambers
parts.evolution: Wall growing taller → wall complete but cracking → window added → door added → wall becomes garden fence

parts.name: The Rule Keeper
parts.function: Maintains rigid structure and order to prevent the chaos that caused the original wound
parts.therapeutic_direction: The rules kept you safe then — do they still serve you now?
parts.visual_description: Rigid figure in precise formal armor holding heavy leather-bound book of rules open, every buckle perfectly fastened, stiff upright posture, surrounded by organized shelves, warm but controlled lighting
parts.evolution: Book clutched tightly → book open on table → some pages torn out → book closed and set aside → figure writes their own book

parts.name: The Tower Architect
parts.function: Designs and maintains the isolation structure — plans the defense but never lives outside it
parts.therapeutic_direction: You designed a perfect fortress — but who is it for?
parts.visual_description: Cloaked figure at drafting table drawing tower blueprints, the designed tower visible through window being built in distance, never looks up from plans, warm amber lamplight
parts.evolution: Drawing towers → drawing bridges → drawing doors → crumpling the plans → looking out the window instead

parts.name: The Warrior Princess Protector
parts.function: Guards the exile with fierce vigilance — no one gets through without passing her
parts.therapeutic_direction: She protects beautifully — but even guards need rest
parts.visual_description: Woman in ornate armor standing guard before locked door, sword drawn across doorway, back to whatever is behind door, eyes scanning outward, door glows faintly warm behind her
parts.evolution: Sword drawn blocking door → sword lowered → stepping aside → opening door → sitting beside what was behind it

parts.name: The Perfectionist
parts.function: Endlessly refines to prevent criticism — if everything is perfect, no one can attack
parts.therapeutic_direction: Nothing is ever good enough because the standard was set by someone who couldn't be pleased
parts.visual_description: Figure endlessly polishing armor that already gleams, cloth in hand examining every surface for flaws, surrounded by discarded imperfect pieces, warm but anxious lighting
parts.evolution: Polishing frantically → polishing slowly → setting cloth down → wearing the imperfect armor → laughing at the scratches

parts.name: The Caretaker
parts.function: Earns safety by being indispensable to others — gives everything, keeps nothing
parts.therapeutic_direction: Healing others to avoid healing self — who takes care of the caretaker?
parts.visual_description: Tired figure carrying too many bundles and bags for others, arms overflowing, head bowed under weight, giving everything away while wearing threadbare clothes, warm golden light on bundles not carrier
parts.evolution: Carrying everything → setting some bags down → asking someone to hold one → hands empty → receiving a gift

parts.name: The Dragon
parts.function: Externalized rage that activates when the exile is threatened — terrifying but protective
parts.therapeutic_direction: The fire is a boy's pain wearing armor — the dragon shrinks when the boy makes peace with his anger
parts.visual_description: Magnificent dragon with ember-glow scales, not breathing fire but smoke curling from nostrils, coiled protectively around something small and unseen, dragon's eyes are a boy's eyes — frightened not angry, warm reds and deep ambers
parts.evolution: Massive and terrifying → smaller and tired → sleeping → sitting beside the boy → the dragon becomes a campfire the boy warms his hands by

parts.name: The Bad Girl
parts.function: Defiance and destruction as defense — if I'm already bad, your rejection can't hurt me
parts.therapeutic_direction: The rage is valid — but destruction isn't freedom
parts.visual_description: Figure wreathed in dark flickering energy, leather and torn cloth, defiant stance with chin raised, one hand crackling with dark fire, beneath defiance her posture is protective — shielding something behind her, warm dark reds and violets
parts.evolution: Dark fire blazing → fire controlled → fire in one hand, open palm in other → fire becomes warmth → standing without fire, still defiant but at peace

parts.name: The Storm
parts.function: Emotional overwhelm externalized as chaos — everything at once, uncontrollable
parts.therapeutic_direction: At the center of every storm is a still, calm eye
parts.visual_description: Humanoid figure made of swirling wind, rain, and lightning, partially formed partially dissolving, arms thrown outward in chaos, but at center is a still calm eye — a small quiet space the storm is built around, muted blues and electric ambers
parts.evolution: Full storm raging → storm with visible eye → storm shrinking to reveal figure inside → gentle rain → clear sky with figure standing in sunlight

parts.name: The Flood
parts.function: Emotional overwhelm as rising water — grief, memory, and feeling rising uncontrollably
parts.therapeutic_direction: The water is not the enemy — it's everything you held back finally moving
parts.visual_description: Figure submerged to chest in rising dark water, arms reaching upward, water is emotion not ocean — tears and memory, objects floating (toy, letter, photograph), warm amber light on surface
parts.evolution: Submerged to neck → chest → waist → standing in shallow water → water receded leaving objects on dry ground to examine

parts.name: The Fire Witch
parts.function: Controlled destructive power — she can direct the fire but cannot stop wielding it
parts.therapeutic_direction: Understanding darkness vs living in it — power that consumes the wielder
parts.visual_description: Woman surrounded by controlled dark flames, hands directing fire in patterns, face intense and focused, fire obeys but she cannot stop without losing control, warm deep oranges against dark background
parts.evolution: Fire controlling her → fire in her hands → fire at her fingertips → fire as candlelight → fire as hearth warmth

parts.name: The Little One in the Locked Room
parts.function: The core wound carrier — locked away by protectors to prevent re-injury
parts.therapeutic_direction: The child has been waiting — not for rescue, but for someone to simply sit with them
parts.visual_description: Small child on floor of dim stone room, knees drawn up, single beam of light from keyhole falling across them, closed door with heavy lock, child not crying but waiting — waiting a long time, warm amber keyhole light against cool shadows
parts.evolution: Locked room → keyhole light widens → door unlocked → door open → child walks out into the light → child is held

parts.name: The Boy in the Bunker
parts.function: The wounded boy who built his own shelter — resourceful exile who survived through withdrawal
parts.therapeutic_direction: The bunker kept you alive — now it's safe to come out
parts.visual_description: Small boy in underground room he built, charcoal drawings on walls, flickering candle, toy soldiers in defense formation around him, eyes old for his age, warm candle glow against cold concrete
parts.evolution: Sealed bunker → candle lit → drawings become murals → skylight added → door open → boy leaves but can always return

parts.name: The Frozen Child
parts.function: The part frozen in the moment of the wound — not pain but numbness, stuck in time
parts.therapeutic_direction: The ice formed slowly over time — it can thaw slowly too
parts.visual_description: Small figure encased in translucent ice from waist down, arms free but held close, ice not violent — formed slowly, expression not pain but numbness, warm light hitting ice creating soft prismatic glow
parts.evolution: Frozen to waist → ice cracking → ice to ankles → standing in puddle → warm ground, barefoot

parts.name: The Hidden One
parts.function: The part that learned safety means invisibility — hiding so practiced it became identity
parts.therapeutic_direction: What would it feel like to be visible and still safe?
parts.visual_description: Child curled behind massive tree roots, barely visible, camouflaged by leaves and shadow, eyes open and watching but body perfectly still, hiding so practiced it has become identity, warm dappled forest light
parts.evolution: Invisible behind roots → partially visible → sitting beside the tree → standing in the open → being seen and not flinching

parts.name: The Abandoned One
parts.function: The part that carries the wound of being left — watches the door where someone walked out
parts.therapeutic_direction: The door someone left through is not the only door in the room
parts.visual_description: Small child sitting alone on stone bench in empty courtyard, doorway behind where someone recently left — door still swinging, child watches door not sky, single dropped toy on ground, warm fading sunset light
parts.evolution: Watching the door → turning away from door → noticing other doors → walking through a different door → someone walks IN through the door

parts.name: Ghost of the Father
parts.function: The inherited masculine pattern — the father's shadow that the son carries without choosing it
parts.therapeutic_direction: He is memory, not person — you can set his shadow down
parts.visual_description: Translucent sepia-toned masculine figure standing in doorway, older architectural style like faded photograph, his shadow falls across floor reaching toward smaller shadow (the client's), expression unreadable — not cruel but not warm, warm sepia and amber
parts.evolution: Looming in doorway → standing in room → sitting down → fading to translucent → becoming a portrait on the wall — honored but no longer haunting

parts.name: Shadow Mother
parts.function: The inherited feminine pattern — presence without contact, hovering without holding
parts.therapeutic_direction: She is presence without contact — you can grieve what she couldn't give
parts.visual_description: Translucent feminine figure standing behind chair where someone recently sat, hands hovering above chair back as if about to touch but never landing, features soft and faded like old painting, presence without contact, warm muted rose and gray
client_language_triggers: she was there but not there
parts.evolution: Hovering behind → hands closer → one hand lands on shoulder → sitting in the chair herself → becoming solid and present → embracing

parts.name: The Ancient Tower Ruins
parts.function: The inherited defense structure — a previous generation's tower now crumbling, showing the pattern repeats
parts.therapeutic_direction: The pattern was built before you — you don't have to rebuild it
parts.visual_description: Remains of tower much older than client's tower, overgrown and crumbling, faded carvings on stones showing patterns the client's tower repeats, warm sepia tones suggesting deep past, the inherited pattern made architectural
parts.evolution: Ruins standing → ruins with flowers growing through → ruins as garden border → stones repurposed into a bridge → the pattern transformed into passage not prison
